00220 - (void) audioQueueInputCallback: (AudioQueueRef) inQ bufferRef: (AudioQueueBufferRef) inQB;
00221 {
00222     static const float oneOverMaxVal = 1.f / (float) 0x7ffe;
00223     
00224     short * const coreAudioBuffer = (short*) inQB->mAudioData;
00225     float * const floatBuffer = aqc->inputInfo.floatBuffer + (FLOATBUFFER_SIZE * aqc->inputInfo.writeIndex);
00226     
00227 //  // temp to stop unused warnings
00228 //  (void)coreAudioBuffer;
00229 //  (void)floatBuffer;
00230 //  (void)oneOverMaxVal;
00231 //  
00232 //  // need to copy coreAudioBuffer -> floatBuffer
00233 //  printf("audioQueueInputCallback: %p\n", inQB);
00234     
00235 //  printf("audioQueueInputCallback ASSUMING 2 CHANNELS !!!!!!\n");
00236     
00237     int numFramesToProcess = aqc->frameCount;
00238     short* inChannel0 = coreAudioBuffer;
00239     float* ugenChannel0 = floatBuffer;
00240     
00241     switch(NUM_CHANNELS)
00242     {
00243         case 1: {
00244             while(numFramesToProcess--)
00245             {
00246                 *ugenChannel0 = (float)(*inChannel0) * oneOverMaxVal;
00247                 inChannel0++;
00248                 ugenChannel0++;
00249             }
00250         } break;
00251         case 2: {
00252             short* inChannel1 = coreAudioBuffer+1;
00253             float* ugenChannel1 = floatBuffer+numFramesToProcess;
00254             
00255             while(numFramesToProcess--)
00256             {
00257                 *ugenChannel0 = (float)(*inChannel0) * oneOverMaxVal;
00258                 *ugenChannel1 = (float)(*inChannel1) * oneOverMaxVal;
00259                 
00260                 inChannel0 += NUM_CHANNELS;
00261                 inChannel1 += NUM_CHANNELS;
00262                 ugenChannel0++;
00263                 ugenChannel1++;
00264             }
00265         }
00266     }
00267     
00268     aqc->inputInfo.writeIndex++;
00269     if(aqc->inputInfo.writeIndex == AUDIO_BUFFERS)
00270         aqc->inputInfo.writeIndex = 0;
00271     
00272     AudioQueueEnqueueBuffer (inQ, inQB, 0, NULL);
00273 }

00275 - (void) audioQueueOutputCallback: (AudioQueueRef) inQ bufferRef: (AudioQueueBufferRef) outQB;
00276 {
00277     static const float maxVal = (float) 0x7ffe;
00278     
00279     int numFramesToProcess = aqc->frameCount;
00280     short * const coreAudioBuffer = (short*) outQB->mAudioData;
00281     float * const outputFloatBuffer = aqc->outputInfo.floatBuffer;
00282     float * const inputFloatBuffer = aqc->inputInfo.floatBuffer + (FLOATBUFFER_SIZE * aqc->inputInfo.readIndex);
00283     
00284     if (numFramesToProcess > 0) 
00285     {
00286         outQB->mAudioDataByteSize = aqc->outputInfo.dataFormat.mBytesPerPacket * numFramesToProcess;
00287         
00288         int blockID = UGen::getNextBlockID(numFramesToProcess);
00289         
00290         for(int channel = 0; channel < aqc->outputInfo.dataFormat.mChannelsPerFrame; channel++)
00291         {
00292             aqc->inputInfo.graph.setInput(inputFloatBuffer + numFramesToProcess * channel, 
00293                                           numFramesToProcess, 
00294                                           channel);
00295             
00296             aqc->outputInfo.graph.setOutput(outputFloatBuffer + numFramesToProcess * channel, 
00297                                             numFramesToProcess, 
00298                                             channel);
00299         }
00300         
00301         aqc->outputInfo.graph.prepareAndProcessBlock(numFramesToProcess, blockID);
00302                 
00303         short* outChannel0 = coreAudioBuffer;
00304         float* ugenChannel0 = outputFloatBuffer;
00305         
00306         switch(NUM_CHANNELS)
00307         {
00308             case 1: {
00309                 while(numFramesToProcess--)
00310                 {
00311                     *outChannel0 = (short)(*ugenChannel0 * maxVal);                 
00312                     outChannel0++;
00313                     ugenChannel0++;
00314                 }
00315             } break;
00316             case 2: {
00317                 short* outChannel1 = coreAudioBuffer+1;
00318                 float* ugenChannel1 = outputFloatBuffer+numFramesToProcess;
00319                 
00320                 while(numFramesToProcess--)
00321                 {
00322                     *outChannel0 = ugen::roundFloatToInt(*ugenChannel0 * maxVal);
00323                     *outChannel1 = ugen::roundFloatToInt(*ugenChannel1 * maxVal);
00324                     
00325                     outChannel0 += NUM_CHANNELS;
00326                     outChannel1 += NUM_CHANNELS;
00327                     ugenChannel0++;
00328                     ugenChannel1++;
00329                 }
00330             } break;
00331             default: {
00332                 for(int sample = 0; sample < FRAME_COUNT; sample++)
00333                 {
00334                     for(int channel = 0; channel < NUM_CHANNELS; channel++)
00335                     {
00336                         int coreAudioIndex = sample * NUM_CHANNELS + channel;
00337                         int floatIndex = sample + FRAME_COUNT * channel;
00338                         coreAudioBuffer[coreAudioIndex] = outputFloatBuffer[floatIndex] * maxVal;
00339                     }
00340                 }   
00341             }
00342         }
00343         
00344         aqc->inputInfo.readIndex++;
00345         if(aqc->inputInfo.readIndex == AUDIO_BUFFERS)
00346             aqc->inputInfo.readIndex = 0;
00347         
00348         AudioQueueEnqueueBuffer(inQ, outQB, 0, NULL);
00349     }   
00350 }
